method.segmentation: Robust Video Matting mobilenetv3 (ONNX, CPU), recurrent temporal state, downsample 0.25; choke 3% + 0.8px soften; motion-adaptive temporal smoothing (static pixels only); no chroma key
method.edgeDecontamination: un-premultiply against a clean apartment plate (temporal median of uncovered pixels, fixed camera)
method.background: Luma VFX-001 output reused as raw plate only: generated person matted out (RVM), temporal median of uncovered pixels, residual hole Telea-inpainted, lanczos 720->1080, night grade + DOF blur + bloom; ambient motion local (fog drift, light flicker, grain)
method.transition: spatial reveal ordered by distance from the subject + room luminance (shadows first), low-frequency organic edge, 0.4-1.9s, warm light-sweep front, local displacement of the apartment at the front
method.subject: original source pixels; fixed per-pixel grade ramp (exposure -7%, warmer, contrast +6%); light wrap on rim only
